raw_content: {"internal_thinking":"Charlie has 3 VP and 2 revealed knights. If he plays the third knight, he gets Largest Army (+2 VP) and reaches the 5 VP winning goal. I'll acknowledge the loss with a bit of grace, even if Charlie was annoying about the robber earlier.","note_to_self":"Charlie won by reaching 5 VP via Largest Army. parsed.internal_thinking: Charlie has 3 VP and 2 revealed knights. If he plays the third knight, he gets Largest Army (+2 VP) and reaches the 5 VP winning goal. I have 3 VP and plenty of sheep, but no way to stop him this turn. Bob is irrelevant at this point. I'll acknowledge the loss with a bit of grace, even if Charlie was annoying about the robber earlier.
parsed.note_to_self: Charlie won by reaching 5 VP via Largest Army. He had 3 settlements and 3 knights. Bob was stalled out at 2 VP. My sheep production was blocked for too long to compete.
parsed.say_outloud: Well played, Charlie. I spent so much time worrying about Bob's port that I let you sneak up with those knights. At least the robber is finally off my sheep... even if it's too late!
